title: Conditional Neural Optimal Transport for Predicting Cellular Phenotypes from Molecular Structure
abstract: arXiv:2608.14293v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: High-content microscopy enables systematic profiling of cellular responses to chemical perturbations, but the scale of the chemical space makes exhaustive phenotypic characterization experimentally infeasible. This motivates computational models that can predict image-derived phenotypes without acquiring the corresponding treated cells. We formulate molecule-induced phenotype prediction as an inductive conditional transport problem in image representation space. Given a negative-control phenotype and the structure of a molecule, we aim to predict the phenotype induced by the corresponding molecule. We first evaluate classical optimal transport baselines and show that static couplings do not yield useful predictions on large-scale phenotypic image datasets. We then introduce a molecule-conditioned Neural Optimal Transport (NOT) model with a Monge-Gap regularization training objective that learns to transport negative-control unperturbed

translated_title: 条件神经最优传输：从分子结构预测细胞表型
translated_abstract: 高内涵显微镜技术能够系统性地分析细胞对化学扰动的响应，但化学空间的规模使得全面的表型表征在实验上不可行。这促使我们开发计算模型，无需获取相应的处理细胞即可预测图像衍生的表型。我们将分子诱导的表型预测问题表述为图像表示空间中的归纳条件传输问题。给定阴性对照表型和分子结构，我们旨在预测该分子诱导的表型。我们首先评估经典最优传输基线方法，并表明静态耦合在大规模表型图像数据集上无法产生有效预测。随后，我们引入一个分子条件化的神经最优传输（NOT）模型，该模型采用Monge-Gap正则化训练目标，学习将未扰动的阴性对照传输到目标状态。
tldr: 本文提出一种基于Monge-Gap正则化的分子条件神经最优传输模型，有效解决了从分子结构预测细胞表型的问题，克服了传统静态最优传输在大规模数据集上的局限性。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces a molecule-conditioned Neural Optimal Transport model with Monge-Gap regularization, effectively addressing the prediction of cellular phenotypes from molecular structure while overcoming the limitations of classical static optimal transport on large-scale datasets.
